name: Ferrum Classbook
notes: Schools can switch the setup how they want. The school software is a selectable profile on the standard Echo server (ECHO_PROFILE=school_student), not a separate fork. The school_student profile is the strict one: students cannot ask Echo to remember personal notes (NEVER tier), saving a page waits for a teacher's approval, and lookups stay AUTO. Home use: a student at home gets a timed Echo session (see home_use); the limit is set by parents and tech departments through the portal, not by students or teachers.
